about: Generic fast engine for any style without its own fast.json: one Claude call writes the whole HyperFrames composition from the style's SKILL.md; lint gates it and a failure goes back for a repair. See services/worker/fast_edit.py.

composition.doc: the complete index.html of the edit: a standalone HyperFrames composition following ENGINE.md, in the look, pacing and motion the style's SKILL.md describes
